paraphrase: Finite interpretations for the two sense forks: for each premise of the joint theorems a model in which the other premises hold and the conclusion fails; a joint nonvacuity witness per fork; and per term a model in which coverage holds, exclusivity fails and two uses of the term stand for different relations. Satisfiability and omission only; no model describes reality.
